meta.name: benchling-integration
meta.description: Benchling Python SDK and REST API integration for registry entities, inventory, ELN entries, workflows, Benchling Apps, and Data Warehouse queries. Use when automating lab data with benchling-sdk or the v2 API.

copy.tagline: 自动管理 Benchling 平台上的实验室数据录入与查询
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你的实验室用 Benchling 管理研发数据,想自动同步和查询。
copy.tagline_en: Automate lab data entry and queries on Benchling
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your lab uses Benchling and needs automated data entry and lookup.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会用 benchling-sdk 或 v2 API 连你的 Benchling 租户，创建和更新 DNA、RNA、蛋白等注册实体，管理库存容器与位置，建 ELN 条目、工作流任务，并查询数据仓库。
howto.when: 当你提到 benchling-sdk、v2 API，或要求自动化处理生物序列、库存样品、ELN 条目等工作时接管。需先配好租户 URL 和 API key 或 OAuth 凭据。

say.text: 把容器 cont_abc123 转移到 box_xyz789 里
列出我租户里所有 DNA 序列并给出总数

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude connects to your Benchling tenant via benchling-sdk or the v2 API: creating and updating registry entities (DNA, RNA, proteins), managing inventory containers and locations, building ELN entries and workflow tasks, and querying the Data Warehouse.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention benchling-sdk or the v2 API, or ask to automate biological sequences, inventory samples, ELN entries, and similar lab data. Requires a tenant URL plus API key or OAuth credentials.

say_en.text: Use benchling-sdk to create a circular DNA sequence named My Plasmid
List all DNA sequences in my tenant and show the total
